name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko Babić's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the digital realm. A prodigious talent in simulation racing during his teenage years, Marko quickly gained a reputation for his strategic acumen and ability to dissect complex race scenarios. This led to an unexpected opportunity as a data analyst for a small GT team, where he quickly impressed with his ability to translate virtual insights into real-world performance gains.

His analytical prowess and sharp understanding of both the technical and human elements of racing saw him rapidly ascend through the ranks. Known for his calm demeanor under pressure and ability to inspire his team, Marko is a firm believer in data-driven decision-making, but always tempered with the intuitive understanding gleaned from years immersed in the sport. At JOTA Sport, he aims to cultivate a culture of innovation and calculated risk-taking, striving to push the boundaries of what's possible in endurance racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Marko has a lean build and an intense, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten race strategy notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every race day with a strong cup of Croatian coffee.
